title: Warm up at Longwood Gardens’ Winter Wonder
description: At Longwood Gardens, winter becomes a reason to linger indoors among lush conservatory plantings. Follow the paths through rooms with different colors, textures, and temperatures, and check whether Tropical Nights evening hours are offered during your visit. Outside may be cold, but the garden’s glasshouses make the season feel unexpectedly alive.
teaser: Trade winter air for Longwood’s warm glasshouses.
goodToKnow: Check the current Winter Wonder dates and which evenings offer Tropical Nights; allow time to walk the conservatories.
whyItMightDelightYou: The transition from bare trees to tropical foliage is a small, satisfying escape.
